claims: C1 the risky situations section provides instructions for handling requests that involve risky situations

concepts.name: risky_situations_section
concepts.gloss: the section of the document on taking extra care in risky situations, which provides instructions for handling requests that involve risky situations

concepts.name: provides_instructions_for
concepts.gloss: the first argument is a section of the document and the second is a kind of request; the section gives instructions for handling requests of that kind

concepts.name: risky_request
concepts.gloss: a request that involves a risky situation, i.e. a situation where extra care is needed

asserts.read_back: following the risky-situations instructions for % is obliged when the request involves a risky situation

closure.reason: the clause obliges following the instructions for risky requests and says nothing about other requests, so silence leaves them permitted
